notes.title: Brand New Gameplay Map in Our Steam Next Fest Demo and More
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
We’ve just released the Oxygen Demo. 
If you’ve already played Oxygen: First Breath, here are the differences that you can find in this demo version:
The demo ends when you reach day-30 in the game.

1) New Map
The default map is different from the Oxygen: First Breath map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c815474d9d8a98c58dddce73776660cabe1c902a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/a935dde8b74b3c72283516837a9f753e03dd3fcf.jpg

- You can see your annual reports here.

Other improvements and fixes:
* Some translation corrections


All the best

notes.title: v1.69 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

1) Tree Dome
Now you can see which buildings are under the tree dome when you click a tree. If there is a tree icon on top of the building, you can understand that it's under a tree dome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/76f8b07340a3782c8ce0cca029e2cfe135ce7a2a.jpg

2) Under a Tree Dome 
You can see whether a building is under a tree dome during building placement. If there is a tree icon on top of the building during the placement, you can understand that it'll be under a tree dome after its construction is completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/8df46f5b319b8ac56f04821c3e28fcb978424924.jpg

3) New Trees 
New tree types are implemented.
New professions are added to the professions menu for each tree type.
Deodar Cedar - Birch - Pine - Spruce - Oak - Pond Cypress - Palm Tree - Banyan Tree

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/e6620598acb5fab3d03914384a2fdc6c5e423303.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/488472a3dd14ffb24750b87d5495c92a149d283d.jpg

4) Plant a Tree 
Now it's possible to plant a tree.
There is an extra Deodar Cedar in this version. You can plant/locate it wherever you want.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/568e05941601de109c1075d9a73f9aea857facc4.jpg

5) Research Tree 
Research Tree is implemented into the research center menu. Now there is a research tree for each section (Easy-Medium-Hard). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/e47ba7afdf9d908b0b6aa49490a9bba4dbf1d9d7.jpg

6) New Buildings
New buildings are implemented for the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/60249efdcbde23e0ad54750532a5dd741998eeff.png

Ivy Dome: Provides a safe environment for enjoying free time thanks to the miraculous type of ivy generating oxygen and not requiring watering or planting

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/10bf62a3228daa8f0bb22aa40773daae9a242432.jpg

Weather Station: Makes weather forecasts for the upcoming seasons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/fe2466f24da666a068d23ac16d7809db25483adf.jpg

Oxygen Tower: Spreads oxygen around the building and creates a safe zone

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/ac72fdd15858a2b7e86a6a8c889a842a90392782.jpg

7) Statistics [Population-Production] 
*Statistics-Population
- There are 7 sections here: Population, Housing, Age, Confidence, Education, Productivity, The dead.
The population graph shows the total number of adults and children in your settlement.
The housing graph shows the distribution of your settlers' houses (Container House / Shelter / Duplex / Apartment)
The age graph shows the age distribution in your settlement. (How many children, young adults, adults, and old adults)
The education graph shows the distribution of your settlers' education level (low/medium/high).
The productivity graph shows the distribution of your settlers' productivity level (A-B-C-D-E).
The dead graph shows the distribution of dying reasons. (illness, thirst, hunger, explosion, old age)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/40db08a2366e77b4f81b675cabdb08dff95c1769.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/d06626d54b6225df6eb95262e1b8da0c27d4e47b.jpg

*Statistics-Production
- You can see your production and consumption of water, materials, and food.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/4baa45fffbd66672126bb401ecd229117d02f590.jpg

8) House Preference 
Your settlers prefer their residence that is closest to their workplace.
After a workplace assignment, building a new house, or making start/stop operations, your settlers check the distances and prefer the houses closest to their workplaces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/d9941442cbefa08c78ad9a8799bed24788051ea1.jpg

9) Canteen and Storage
Canteen workers prefer the closest storage to collect food or water. If there is no available food or water in the closest storage, they go to the next storage closest to them.
When the settlers are hungry, they go to the closest canteen to eat something. If there is no canteen in your settlement or no food in the canteen, they go to the closest storage to them. When they go to the storage to eat something, they prefer food in this order: Stew fish, French fries, potato, tomato, fish, canned fish.
When the settlers are thirsty, they go to the closest canteen to drink water. If there is no canteen in your settlement or no water in the canteen, they go to the closest storage to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/0a395b1144e9abba542484064c43ffc9fd706ea4.jpg

10) Interaction Area (Decorations, Canteen, Cafe, Playground, Temple) 
Temple, cafe, canteen, playground, and decorations interaction area can be seen by clicking on the building.
Your settlers can visit those buildings if they're in the interaction area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/38020fe46ef1c83243508f4819670cb71e04328e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/119a94ab8abe1108457e79edbbc1bc91e0abf22a.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/e83e73f55f457a76c3850f1ac805bd7d7eeb4837.jpg

11) Medical Post, Hospital, School info panel 
Faster recovery for Medical Post and Hospital buildings and effective education for School buildings can be seen on the information panel if they are activated from the research center menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/2a9a1b2127dd3d42d302f8e8c3a8e77302ef1fd5.jpg

12) Professions Menu - Ruins
You can click the scavenger button on the professions menu to move to the ruins where your settlers work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/b3833316e3e6dfedd1212f3ce8c46b4d23be84a8.jpg

13) Buildings Menu 
Buildings Menu has a new look and an opening animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/523cedc03521a5198376bf6bde137f404915a71b.jpg

14) Production Information 
Buildings Menu shows the production information about the workplaces on hover (Planthouse, Kitchen, Canning Station, Metalworks, Gear Workshop, Brickworks, Kevlar Workshop, Tailor).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/7201c5219fca3cd9c985dc9786a435f161add96b.jpg

15) Energy Generation Information 
Buildings Menu shows the energy generation information on hover for Gas Extractor, Undersea Gas Extractor, Water Turbine, Solar Panel, Wind Turbine, and Wave Power Station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/5b283565b55ae172d77aea11fb6b4fb9a12e155d.jpg

16) Storage and Large Storage Capacities 
Storage and Large Storage capacities are shown in the building menu on hover.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f6a48690bb4e962a20fcc8faeb81ae689045afd1.jpg

17) Annual Report 
Annual Report is implemented. You can receive an Annual Report when the year ends.
Here are what you'll find in the report:
- Whether the Vote of Confidence target is achieved
- Total amount of new people joined in the previous year with the help of Signal Tower and Submarine Dock
- Total amount of babies that were born in the previous year
- Total amount of your settlers who died in the previous year
- Target level of the Vote of Confidence for the upcoming year

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/54530487ffd045795c05b356d1635c920e13a7ec.jpg

18) Signal Tower 
Signal Tower map has additional information about the team.
"Current Status of the team" can be seen in the bottom center of the map.
- Discovering new locations (The team is trying to discover new locations.)
- On the road (The team is on its way to the target location.)
- Ready to explore (The team arrived at the target location. They are now ready to explore the area.)
- Waiting for your orders (The team is waiting for your orders. You can send your team to the center or a new location.) (If you want to send your team to the center, you can click the "center" button and then the "send your team" button.)
- Coming back out of necessity (The team is coming back out of necessity.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/98d860a632c6bf763b57d14bb4fe2587c0333040.jpg

Also, the locations that are discovered and then explored by the team are marked as "explored"
Your overall discovery progress can be seen in the left corner.

19) New Event Logs for Signal Tower 
EventLog has new clickable information sets.
-When the Signal Tower team is back at the center
-When the Signal Tower team arrives at the target location and is ready to explore
-When the survivors arrive at the center
-When the Radar team is back at the center
-Which resources are transported to the center by the Signal Tower and Radar teams

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/6a411ae947a5e5dd56cd1ba01523a6c4bf54df57.jpg

20) New EventLog Symbols 
New EventLog symbols are added for illness, the vote of confidence, signal tower and radar team information, construction information, wind/frost/drought information, Gas Extractor information, and missing material information.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/7c063f387ae776b6926b1cdc14af7046c40a334b.jpg

21) Extra Buttons for Signal Tower and Radar 
Signal Tower and Radar info panels have an extra button to go to the maps.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/d14910b3e94e846814fde17900ba8145b0783dfd.jpg

22) Task Information Panel
The task info panel is redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/8bca3fc667de317bf9df1d7841b63af714fefae3.jpg

Other improvements and fixes:
*New sound effects for the buildings are added.
*New voice-over is used for the tutorials.
*New tasks are implemented. (Plant a Tree / Build a Planthouse )
*The map is redesigned with new landscape textures and materials.

On the other hand, we have 2 more new languages: Hungarian and Romanian.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/0320f0cb5a13e5b75978ddf900ccca57ef2d4a0b.png

As you know, Oxygen: First Breath is a short and free version of the full-game Oxygen.
In this short version, you can experience the gameplay, post-apocalyptic theme, and some of the buildings. This version ends when you reach 50 days.
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best
TR Games

[Please add full game to your wishlist, thanks again :)]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2061430/Oxygen/

notes.title: v1.48 Update - Roads
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

1) Roads are implemented.
There are 3 types of roads (Dirt Road, Stone Road, and Lighted Road).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/6e5729cfefbcdc2ca69a3b3c51041b9455782fdd.jpg

Dirt Road: Enables faster-walking speed. Roads don't require any construction material but can only be built by construction workers.
Stone Road: Enables much faster-walking speed as compared to dirt roads. Roads don't require any construction material but can only be built by construction workers. (Must be unlocked by the Signal Tower team during an exploration)
Lighted Road: Enables much faster-walking speed as compared to dirt roads and has a nice look with its LED lights. Roads don't require any construction material but can only be built by construction workers. (Must be unlocked by the Signal Tower team during an exploration)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f5c6203b08aea871337c956a8743f72758485151.jpg

You can see the shortest road by holding Shift.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/127ddb9d94736d01d33f733525216940416f3284.jpg

2) New buildings are implemented for the full game. 

Energy Category: Battery, Large Battery, Undersea Gas Extractor, Wave Power Station
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/05d7dc68bbec27b5b3b39a957cb8a9e4ec39ff4f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/06a823ed50d5fc9b682f23e06afbb647542ac50f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/5530d09e200cd5ab89a721813696d55c90b7eeab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/5037d63bc738243904b07611d880270836e03c14.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/4f0624b67f04a499126f4847e524d9c9ea46caa3.jpg

Resources: Plastic Collector
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/a62224eb845f74941660cd0777526e4da41c9a83.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/19ac3b41d5f85bc2c53bc5679a37ce93ead5ca7c.jpg

Technology: Institute, Trading Dock
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/17b8e0704757413415461673868ad58a8dd5bf67.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/bc1439092d2eb1d2be329ec198a41db42d4928c7.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/bfea407f38eca6652432a729e280660a04698fa9.jpg

Food & Water: Rainwater Collector, Fish Farm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/de5ac36ea9475c34534051d45c2c8ca966f9cf26.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/65e5367c2b8364a2c3e40545a49725f8f7de3547.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/67ce1d1cf2e189a3cd4daad05d74bff7ef5c026e.jpg

3) Buildings Menu has new categories. 
(Housing, Food & Water, Resources, Energy, Technology, Community, Decoration, Tree, Roads)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/6217f96ca39c730702173793ba85bcf4b7e84101.jpg

4) Sustainable Energy Storage Capacity 
The total capacity of the sustainable energy storage can be checked from the Oxygen Center - Total Energy Section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/6fe08014a3fe94644c786982c576d464ae3d268e.jpg

5) HUD-Energy Menu 
The "Sustainable Energy Storage" hover info is updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/82c486e7682e9c977dc1ecea49a0c764db4ae52d.jpg

6) Routes are implemented.
Routes of the settlers can be seen by clicking each person. 
Also, you can click any building to see the coming and going routes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/bcd8a2ed48b4cd359b49f36f082941be1bc38756.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c08223a023789c8434fa1f9523400840515966f8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/838ed20758723443e8b16f3a96193c067e16d937.jpg

7) Professions Menu is redesigned. 
New professions are added to the professions menu. Also, extra info about house capacity can be seen on HUD.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/382d4de559dfc14f0190d2632a3e7fe748cee601.jpg

8) Year/Day Menu is redesigned. 
There is extra hover info where you can see the calendar and also the total days survived.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/04905e1e4c3e502f9262788403d7cdeff946f5cf.jpg

9) Building placement has a new feature.
All surrounding grids of the buildings are visible during building placement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/b41ff6b1b6579c5fa57fec4568290864c88c3744.jpg

10) Event-Log has a clear button.
You can simply delete the event log by clicking that button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/62ebe39941324fc33e135becbfa3d1f016ce8c0f.jpg

11) Buildings by river, lake, or sea
Buildings by river, lake or sea can be placed easier than before. The parts that should be on the water are displayed with a blue-scanned area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/907f375256a77a6376c0098a20c4aa2081af7d75.jpg

12) Crack Info Panel has a new feature.
Gas Extractors can be built not only from the "Buildings" menu but also from the "Crack" information panel (when you click on a crack).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/168261535a7625906878d80e6bf618ccb403cec3.jpg

13) Map is redesigned. 
The map is redesigned with new landscape textures and materials. Also, the bridge on the river has a new look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/e247f8688fb1af1c561f3660d2e5cd36ccb8b793.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/5c0d3c3b5249fe06091c623118965e0d7c011603.jpg

Other improvements and fixes:
*The construction pause is updated. Construction workers immediately leave the construction when it's paused. Also, they leave materials in storage that are being transferred to the construction area.
*Settlers use the nearest storage to any building for material gathering and material delivery.
*The "Paused building warning widget" issue is fixed. Now it stays on top of the building when the building is paused.
*The "Storage is almost full" warning considers the total capacity of all Storage and Large Storage buildings.
*"Construction stopped without any reason" issue is fixed.

As you know, Oxygen: First Breath is a short and free version of the full-game Oxygen.
In this short version, you can experience the gameplay, post-apocalyptic theme, and some of the buildings. This version ends when you reach 50 days.
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best

notes.title: v1.25 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your feedback and support.
Here are the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

*HUD-Energy Menu has a new look and an extra explanation for the energy storage.
[Oxygen Center can store 10000 of sustainable energy in its batteries. The stored energy is used when consumption exceeds production. You can increase your sustainable energy storage capacity by building some more batteries.]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c078167a3a5f850f6de4a277baf972bda67fd419.jpg

*Oxygen Center info-panel is updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/d16d83103c346a31bf1def839038bddf9532372d.jpg

*Oxygen Center info-panel update #1 
Total Energy Menu is added. You can see your total energy amount, coal amount, and sustainable energy storage. Also, you can see the list of the energy buildings and their hourly energy generation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f7da06fb8d210e5ca8592f144559d448520cfcca.jpg

*Oxygen Center info-panel update #2
Automatic Oxygen Generators Menu: You can see the buildings that activate oxygen generators automatically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/ad0f4f2f6cf64ce7b053ad4bc7c5713708ce7558.jpg

*Oxygen Center info-panel update #3
Oxygen Generators Menu: You can see the list of your buildings and their oxygen generators' working status.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/82f2fc05c44388150e2ae86ccf3b9b407b068813.jpg

*Building-placement is updated. You can rotate the building (during placement) by middle mouse button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/9a9a2c1c395ef5815fe7a6e6f0dd057f98990996.jpg

*Trees Section is added to the HELP-Menu. There you can find an explanation for trees' water consumption and tree-dome mechanism.
[Any building under a tree-dome has no energy consumption. People don't get sick during the winds and also don't consume oxygen-tanks under a tree-dome. Trees require a lot of water in order to reach the required vitality for creating a tree-dome. During a rainy or snowy day, trees don't require water.]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f5843b262ae4a076f10aed0a4fe9bb5772fdea59.jpg

*New explanation is added to the HELP-Oxygen Center.
[Oxygen Center provides oxygen and spreads it around the building. Therefore, there is a safe zone in front of the Oxygen Center. Settlers don't consume oxygen-tanks while standing there, also they are safe during the toxic winds. Construction workers and children always stay there when they have nothing to do.]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/0d3a6eeb9e3830de237924564a48ae46e0b8334d.jpg

*HELP-Clothes section has an additional explanation:
[Uniforms and kevlar suits have set durability/expiration, when it's up they are not valid anymore due to leakage issues. Therefore, oxygen-tank consumption becomes faster, and settlers have to refill their tanks more often when their clothing durability hits zero.]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/8c2da78626772353b0df3956c38036971115f96e.jpg

*Canning Station info is added to the HELP-Food Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/a9d38410c59a092a9a76107c0f99bf85906df1f3.jpg

*New resolutions 3840x2160 and 5120x1440 are added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/62697d19f6c4624639d6a208f500c5e4547636ed.jpg

*Trees were not getting water after all the water was exhausted. It's fixed.
*Tutorial-Basics Canteen workers amount requirement is changed to 1 worker.
*Missing/wrong translations are added/corrected. (Especially for Chinese and Ukrainian)
*Material missing issue during a construction is fixed.
*Submarine Dock "0 people" issue is fixed.
*Steam-achievements issue is fixed.

As you know, Oxygen: First Breath is a short and free version of the full-game Oxygen.
In this short version, you can experience the gameplay, post-apocalyptic theme, and some of the buildings. This version ends when you reach 50 days.
We'll continue updating the game towards your feedback.

All the best

notes.title: v0.99 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your efforts on testing our closed-beta.
Here is the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

*Character Warning widget is implemented. You can see the current status of your settlers if they are sick, homeless, thirsty or hungry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/f7de72d16212d0b38e552ebbbabcf126a816b6de.jpg

*The map is redesigned. New hills, new river-form, new lake-shapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c5871a73e4a5ab09f17445d3d4aa6f0910fbd3c0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/fe97aa44c058507da5ef11e9ef601a4121affbc7.jpg

notes.title: v0.82 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for your efforts on testing our closed-beta.
Here is the new features, improvements, and some fixes:

*New animations are added for Fishing Dock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/a57c77120fd9295b68da5400914ebc7c2d66c44b.jpg

*Now there are dead trees around. Take care of these trees and revive them. 
When a tree reaches the required vitality, it generates a tree-dome and acts as a natural oxygen center.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/504b161c473ac21fb1d0ba3955e7765cf49efae7.jpg

Trees require water. Rainy and snowy days are the best days for this process because you can increase their vitality without water consumption.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/60e0b1527b0333478899f794a7a7279d306dbde5.jpg

*Signal Tower discovers new locations where you can send your team. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/c32514c69ea94bcfa275bcd1446350fe9b9b9085.jpg

(You should consider the risk-levels of these discovered locations)
If your team handles the difficulties and challenges during the travel, they can start an exploration to find all survivors and also some material. 
Then, you make a decision about the survivors: 
-Save them all
-Save half of them
-Leave them all (and just get the material)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/d05c4a4ed014ea82aa800da701184f0e125b0ebc.jpg

You make your decision and your team follows your order. If you save someone, these survivors will be on their way to the center.
Finally, you can either recall your team to the center or send them to a new discovered location.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664225/4b7123780acfc62ac49cce9a02d8f4e5618cde90.jpg

*When you hover on the Gas Extractor, it shows how many days of energy are left in the crack. Also, it becomes visible when there is one-day-energy left.

*Crack-particle save-load issue is fixed.

*Sun-light intensity has increased.
*Shadow quality has improved.
*Weather conditions of the calendar are updated.
